title: corydalis gigantea var. genuina
intro: Corydalis gigantea var. genuina, commonly known as Himalayan corydalis, is a species of flowering plant in the poppy family. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Corydalis gigantea var. genuina are attributed to its ability to interact with opioid receptors in the brain, providing relief from pain and promoting relaxation. Bioactive constituents of the plant include compounds such as dehydrocorybulbine (DHCB), protopine, and berberine, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
